name: Som da Rua Orchestra
description: The Som da Rua Orchestra performs on Aliados with a grand-scale performance featuring a host of amateur choirs.
longDescription:
The Som da Rua Orchestra presents a large-scale musical event on Avenida dos Aliados. This performance is notable for its collaborative nature, bringing together the orchestra with numerous amateur choirs from the local community. The initiative aims to showcase musical talent and foster community engagement through a collective artistic endeavor.

Attendees can expect an outdoor concert atmosphere in one of Porto's most prominent public spaces. The grand setting of Avenida dos Aliados provides a suitable backdrop for a performance of this scale, accommodating a large audience. The event is designed to be accessible to a wide range of visitors, offering a communal musical experience.

Admission to the Som da Rua Orchestra performance is free of charge. The venue, Avenida dos Aliados, is centrally located and easily accessible via public transport. Trindade metro station is a 5-minute walk away, and numerous bus lines also serve the area. The event is family-friendly.
